name: Graduate College Image of Research Competition 2027
organizer: Graduate College, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign
description: Image of Research is a Graduate College competition in which Illinois graduate students, including those in health science fields, submit an image and a short narrative connecting visual art to their research, judged by a jury and a public People's Choice vote with an exhibition of finalists. For the 2026 competition, People's Choice voting closed April 10, 2026 and winners were announced April 13, 2026; the submission window for 2026, and any 2027 dates, were not published on the pages retrieved as of September 2026.

sources.note: lists submission requirements; states 2026 submission period is closed but does not give the closed dates
confirms 2026 voting closed April 10 and winners announced April 13

notes: Submission-opening and submission-deadline dates for the graduate competition itself were not found on the pages retrieved, only the voting and announcement dates for the 2026 cycle. A separate undergraduate Image of Research competition also exists at the same site.
